core_obligations: Local presentation: at a point of the ringed space the proof chooses a neighbourhood on which the module admits a presentation by two finite free modules (proof lines 1687-1697)

Lift and split: after shrinking the neighbourhood the generators of the free module can be lifted along the given surjection to the middle term of the presentation and, in the other direction, the presentation map can be factored through the given surjection, giving two maps between the free modules whose composite relations are controlled (proof lines 1698-1707)

Surject onto the kernel: the direct sum of the first map of the presentation and the complement of the composite of the two constructed maps surjects onto the kernel of the given surjection, exhibiting it as generated by finitely many sections (proof lines 1708-1714)

Second assertion: for a surjection from a module of finite type the proof chooses locally a surjection from a finite free module and applies the first part to the composite, then observes that the kernel of the given surjection is the image of the kernel of the composite (proof lines 1716-1720)
proof_roadmap: 在 x 的邻域上取有限表现 O_U^{⊕m} --χ--> O_U^{⊕n} --φ--> F|_U → 0；把 ψ(e_k) 沿 φ 提升为 ẽ_k 得 α，再取 β 使 ψ∘β = φ。
于是 O_U^{⊕m} ⊕ O_U^{⊕r} --(β∘χ, 1-β∘α)--> O_U^{⊕r} 满射到 Ker ψ；(2) 局部取 O_X^{⊕r} → G 满并用 (1) 于 θ∘η，注意 Ker θ = η(Ker(θ∘η))。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows, for a module of finite presentation on a ringed space, that the kernel of a surjection from a finite free module and the kernel of a surjection from any module of finite type are again of finite type (author lemma at source lines 1673-1683, label lemma-kernel-surjection-finite-free-onto-finite-presentation). The proof (source lines 1685-1721) works locally with a presentation of the module, lifts the generators along the given surjection, uses the presentation map in the reverse direction to build the map (\beta \circ \chi, 1 - \beta \circ \alpha) which surjects onto the kernel (proof lines 1708-1714), and then reduces the second assertion to the first by factoring through a finite free module. The explicit surjection onto the kernel is the content. H2.
